panel.puedesPonerPidesCambio: What you can offer and what you ask in return. Clubs see it in the directory and they write to you.
panel.saleDirectorioEmpresasVen: It appears in the company directory and is seen by clubs looking for exactly that.
panel.concretoPrimeroVecesUnico: Be specific. It's the first thing, and sometimes the only thing, the club reads.
panel.haceTeEncuentreClub: This is what lets a club looking for exactly this find you.
panel.dejaloBlancoSiPuedes: Leave it blank if you can reach the whole country.
panel.orientativoAcabaisAcordarClub: A guide figure. You and the club agree the final amount.
panel.frecuenciaParaCuantasPersonas: How often, for how many people, on what terms.
panel.nuestraClinicaBenidormCita: At our clinic in Benidorm, by appointment, Monday to Friday.
panel.esperasClubSiNo: What you expect from the club. If you don't ask for anything, say so too: it helps more than it seems.
panel.nuestroLogoCamisetaEntrenamiento: Our logo on the training shirt and one mention a month
panel.quienHablaClubCuando: Who the club talks to when it calls.
panel.correoTelefonoBastaPero: An email or phone number is enough, but the more you add, the easier you make it. They're the same for all your offers.
panel.noSalenEscritosPagina: They aren't written out on the page: the club has to press a button to see them, so you don't end up on spam lists. If you untick this, nobody will be able to contact you from here.
panel.veClubAntesEscribirte: What a club sees before writing to you.
panel.cuadradoVeMejorPuedes: Square looks best. You can change it whenever you like.
panel.osDedicaisDosPalabras: What you do, in a few words.
panel.maximo600CaracteresQuien: Up to 600 characters. Who you are and why grassroots sport matters to you.
panel.comoTeEscribenClubes: How clubs get in touch with you. It's the same as the publish form asks for.
panel.listadoPublicoEmpresasClubes: The public list of companies clubs browse to know who to write to.
panel.haceNoTengasEstar: So you don't have to keep logging in to check.
panel.quieroAparecerClubesMe: I want to appear and have clubs write to me
panel.siPublicasOfertaEsto: If you publish an offer this switches on by itself: an offer nobody can see is no use. Turning it off removes you from the directory, and your offers disappear with you.
panel.avisameCuandoClubBusque: Let me know when a club is looking for something I offer
panel.correoComoMuchoDia: One email a day at most, only with what matches your categories. If you've set a province, only from clubs in your province.
panel.fichaPublica: Your profile is now public. <enlace>See how clubs see it</enlace>.
panel.traidos: We've moved {n, plural, one {what you had saved} other {the # things you had saved}} in this browser to your account. You'll now see them from any device.
panel.avisoModoPruebas: Your business is in test mode: you can use your dashboard as usual, but your profile and what you offer are not shown in the directory.
